scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Sharp nodal length on smooth surfaces” (preprints/Sharp-nodal-length-on-smooth-surfaces-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 350 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1301138f44ca53ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (M, g) be a closed connected C∞ Riemannian surface. There is a finite constant C = C(M, g) such that every nonzero real Laplace eigenfunction satisfying −Δgu = λu, λ > 0, obeys H1 g(Zu) ≤ C √ λ. Here H1 g is Hausdorff measure for the Riemannian distance. The same constant applies to every eigenfunction in every positive eigenspace.
